rationale: The exact decision's provisional NO recommendation is supported within the supplied source perimeter. EO 13836 §§1–9, 83 FR 25329–25334 (PDF pp.1–6). Section 3 establishes the labor-relations group, member assistance, information/model rules/analysis and an 18-month report. Sections 4–5 impose bargaining objectives, reports, procedures and agency-head review; §6 prohibits permissive-subject negotiations; §7 limits procedures/arrangements bargaining; §8 requires CBA/award submissions and public access. Timetables and completed agreements cannot exhaust this continuing package by themselves. EO 14003 §3(a), 86 FR 7231 (PDF p.1), revokes EO 13836, disbands its working group, and directs withdrawal of inconsistent group materials. Sections 3(e)–(f), PDF pp.1–2, address agency implementation separately. This covers all original commands rather than only disbanding the group. EO 13836 §9(c) preserves CBAs already in effect, and §9(a) preserves statutory authority. A surviving agreement does not maintain an independent EO-command regime. EO 14003's qualified cleanup allows agency/legal implementation issues to persist without qualifying its express revocation. EO 14148 §2(o), PDF p.2, revokes EO 14003, while §3(b), p.5, directs review and possible further action. Full text supplies no affirmative revival of EO 13836 or its group. Similar future policy or the continued existence of a CBA would require separate evidence.
remaining_source_action: Obtain working-group meeting/report and withdrawal records, bargaining and CBA records, and applicable judicial/agency actions; test completion and earlier cessation of each reporting, group, bargaining and disclosure command.

Their supplied fingerprints are pinned, not independently reconstructed here. Status acceptance uses positive primary-source revocation and the complete supplied contrary text; it is not an exhaustive absence-of-restoration claim through cutoff.
